name: bench-v1 r89 / score-v6 / rules-v5
user_words: Once the approved labels and scoring decisions are recorded: 1. Renew approval of the revised benchmark. 2. Freeze its label version and scoring rules.
note: The yardstick for the clean-C, H, I and J comparisons. Scores report freeze.matches; one that does not match is not comparable. Match adjudications are judgments on model output, not part of the yardstick: new runs add entries for their own doubtful matches (unadjudicated_low_meaning must be 0 before a recall is final), and existing entries are never edited.
